subject: GO/NO-GO: MAP execution checklist and onboarding start window
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP execution — checklist and target start window

Jane / Acme procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive eval cycle. Per our roadmap call, attached is the most recent MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) that captures the remaining evaluation items, decision gates, and the final go/no-go checklist. Top-line asks from our side to close the loop: 

- Confirm legal/finance signoff date for the SLA Addendum (see SOW section on start date dependencies).
- Confirm who will be the signer (procurement contact vs legal counsel) and expected signature timeline.
- Confirm proposed onboarding start window (we suggested March 1–8).

Key items in the attached MAP_v3.xlsx: scope, acceptance criteria, performance SLO targets, required evidence (SOC2 + audit log extract), and the final operational kickoff steps. If you can reply with a single email that states: (1) go/no-go decision target date, (2) signer name/email, and (3) preferred kickoff week, we will prepare the DocuSign packet and schedule the internal kickoff.

Also copying Rishi and Marissa for pricing and legal clarifications.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP execution — checklist and target start window

Thanks, Soojin —

We reviewed the MAP and have two clarifications before we commit to a go/no-go date: 

1) For the SOC2 evidence, can you confirm the retention window for audit logs once the integration is live? Our security needs a 13-month retention baseline.
2) On pricing: we need an explicit note about overage handling for the first quarter post-launch (spike protection).

Procurement is tentatively okay with a March 1 start but we need legal to confirm the SLA terms. I will escalate to our legal counsel today and aim to respond with a target decision by Tue 2026-02-17.

Regards,
Jane Ellis
Director, Platform Integrations | Acme Corp
jane.ellis@acme.com

Hi Jane —

Quick answers to your items (pulling from the SLA_Addendum.pdf we shared internally):
- Audit log retention: Redwood can provide a 13-month retention export on request; for a standing retention requirement we can propose a managed retention addendum (short clause in SLA_Addendum.pdf).
- Overage protection: we can include a 10% buffer for the first 90 days after launch with auto-notifications and a one-time credit for any billable spike >50% relative to forecast. We will put the exact language into the SLA addendum before putting to legal.

If Acme is comfortable with those guardrails, Soojin — can you confirm procurement will issue a PO and who the signer will be so we can prepare DocuSign?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

Soojin / Rishi —

We have a conditional PO ready (ACME_PO_4512.pdf attached). Legal requested the final SLA_Addendum language in writing before signature; they indicated a one-business-day review once they receive the updated addendum. Signer will be: Mark Holloway <mark.holloway@acme.com> (VP Finance).

Requested timeline: 
- Please send revised SLA_Addendum.pdf with the 13-month retention clause and the 90-day buffer language by EOD 02/17 so legal can review.
- If legal approves on 02/18, we expect signature by 02/19 and prefer kickoff week starting 03/01.
